title: Long-wave (> 2300 nm) eligibility
description: White-reference signal falls to about 25% at 2300-2400 nm, so the long-wave tail can be noise (PLAN v3.2 Step 2c). On any stream that is not the native standard-resolution scan (a correction applied, unless near-uncorrected: check.acquisition std_like_within; or another instrument's scan as measured; DECISIONS 137) the tail is 'tail-unreliable' when the noise SD of the 2350 nm reading, propagated through the stream's correction, times the as-measured N2(2300-2400) exceeds the cut: B9 and C1 then run their validated truncated variants (no data above 2300 nm; each check file's 'truncated' block), or return 'not assessed: long-wave region too noisy' if the mode says so. The cut is per check, in SD units: B9 uses b9_sd_above, C1 (the contaminant check only) c1_sd_above. A native standard-resolution scan, also through a near-uncorrected correction, is not assessed (its tail is used as today). Nothing else in v1 reads above 2300 nm.

provenance.basis: Phase 0a; Phase 0b item 10. Cut 150 on the as-measured N2(2300-2400) of high-res scans (a high-resolution variation set: median 100, 90th percentile 133; a noisy high-resolution session runs 166-1,695; standard-resolution reference bone median 11-30). Truncated variants validated in item 10: B9 clean-pool minimum 0.457 (0 of 1,201 fail); C1 out-of-fold false alarms 0.50% (full 0.58%); under added tail noise the truncated variants vary 2-3x less than the full ones.
provenance.c1_cut: Phase 0c (DECISIONS 76): full C1 keeps clean false alarms at 0.5-1.0% up to a high-resolution N2(2300-2400) of about 250 (1.4% at 250-300, 3.4% at 300-400; C1 gate at its limit), so C1 runs full up to 250 for the contaminant check only; B9 keeps 150. The truncated C1 drops the 2350 nm band and is blind to cellulose-nitrate glues and animal glue.
provenance.any_correction: DECISIONS 137 (g2): the cuts are v0.2's 150 (B9) and 250 (C1) on N2(2300-2400) turned into SD units once (the tail reading's noise gain through v0.2 x the cut); on the high-resolution sets in hand this reproduces every v0.2 long-wave call. Implied N2 cuts: no correction 70 / 117, a FieldSpec 3-like correction 39 / 65, a standard-resolution unit's own file 74 / 124.

tail_statistic.of: the 2350 nm band reading on the C1 kernel (the long-wave part C1 and B9 read)

modes.truncated: run the check's validated variant without data above 2300 nm (its 'truncated' block)
modes.not_assessed: return 'not assessed: long-wave region too noisy'
